en.title: Wall Street suffers historic AI-driven tech stock crash
en.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst session in months, wiping out over **$2.5 trillion** in market value as fears over an **AI speculative bubble** resurfaced. This historic drop was triggered by political shifts and growing public backlash against the **massive resource consumption** of AI data centers, reminding investors that the technology must face physical constraints.
en.long_summary:
## Market Crash and Political Triggers
On Thursday, the Nasdaq plunged by 5.5%, marking its worst session since April 2025 and wiping out over $2.5 trillion in market value. This sudden correction followed the Democratic Party's midterm election victory, which heightened fears of **tighter regulation** over AI development and stricter local opposition to data centers.

## Physical and Financial Realities
The explosive growth of AI has been fueled by stratospheric valuations and massive debt-driven funding. However, the technology faces mounting hurdles, including the **enormous consumption** of electricity and water by data centers, which have sparked local pushback and highlighted questions about long-term profitability.

## Economic Implications
AI has recently become a primary engine of U.S. economic growth, supported by heavy infrastructure investments and stock market wealth effects. A lasting loss of confidence could trigger a **vicious cycle**, turning AI from an economic driver into a major vulnerability for the broader economy.

zh.title: 华尔街科技股遭遇历史性暴跌，AI泡沫面临现实考验
zh.summary: 纳斯达克指数遭遇数月来最大单日跌幅，蒸发超过 **2.5万亿美元** 市值，引发市场对 **人工智能投机泡沫** 破裂的担忧。这场暴跌由政治变局和公众对AI数据中心 **巨量资源消耗** 的强烈反对共同触发，给盲目狂热的投资者敲响了警钟。
zh.long_summary:
## 市场崩盘与政治导火索
美东时间周四，纳斯达克指数暴跌5.5%，创下2025年4月以来最惨淡的一天，单日蒸发市值超过2.5万亿美元。民主党在中期选举中的大胜成为了导火索，让市场意识到未来可能会面临更严格的 **人工智能监管**，各地民众对数据中心的抵触情绪也日益高涨。

## 现实约束与资金狂热
此前，AI行业的估值全靠对未来的疯狂押注和巨额借贷支撑。但随着发展深入，数据中心带来的 **惊人水电消耗** 引发了当地居民的强烈反对，加上投资回报率不明朗，高昂的现实成本正逐渐浮出水面，泡沫开始显现脆弱性。

## 对宏观经济的影响
在短短几个月内，AI已经成为美国经济增长的重要支柱。如果资本信心持续崩溃，引发资金撤退和项目延期，AI很可能会从经济发动机变成美国经济的 **阿喀琉斯之踵**，带来难以估量的连锁反应。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Agent Systems
en.summary: GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pulled together 15 **design patterns** for building multi-agent AI systems, showing how to make different AI tools **work together** reliably instead of relying on just one.
en.long_summary: As AI agents move beyond simple single-task assistants, coordinating multiple agents effectively has become a major challenge. GitHub, Google, and Siemens have recently published 15 core design patterns drawn from real-world engineering experience. GitHub focuses on schema-driven execution and model context protocols to keep agent outputs predictable. Google highlights patterns like sub-pipelines and reviewer loops, where tasks are broken down and checked iteratively by separate agents. Meanwhile, Siemens tackles enterprise-scale challenges, such as using Knowledge Fabric to integrate fragmented codebases and documents. Together, these patterns offer a comprehensive playbook for building reliable, production-ready multi-agent systems.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合公开：AI多Agent系统的15个实用设计模式
zh.summary: GitHub、谷歌和西门子联合梳理出了15个搭建AI多Agent系统的**设计模式**，教你如何让多个AI像团队一样**高效配合**，解决单兵作战的各种难题。
zh.long_summary: 随着AI技术从单兵作战走向团队协作，怎么让多个AI Agent（智能体）配合得更好成了大难题。最近，GitHub、谷歌和西门子三家巨头把各自在工程实践中的宝贵经验打包，总结出了15个核心的**设计模式**。GitHub主要分享了如何通过规范的数据格式和控制协议，让AI干活时更听话、更少出乱子；谷歌则重点介绍了任务拆解、多步流水线以及互相检查的**工作流设计**，防止AI犯迷糊；西门子则结合工业实际，展示了如何把零散的代码和文档组织起来，让AI在庞大的企业知识库中精准找到答案。这套方法论为开发者打造靠谱的AI协作系统提供了极具价值的参考。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports Multi-Instance GPU to cut AI costs
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports **NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG)**, allowing users to split a single physical GPU into **isolated partitions**. This update helps businesses run multiple models on one GPU without performance interference, maximizing hardware utilization and **cutting AI deployment costs**.
en.long_summary:
## Background and Limitations
Deploying AI models to cloud GPUs traditionally required requesting at least one whole accelerator, leading to wasted resources. Smaller models couldn't fully utilize a massive GPU, forcing users to either waste money on unused capacity or struggle with complex **self-managed Kubernetes** clusters to achieve hardware partitioning.

## How It Works
Amazon SageMaker now integrates NVIDIA MIG natively, removing the need for underlying platform management. Users can define a **partition layout** directly in their endpoint configuration and assign models to specific slices using inference components. This provides **hardware-level isolation**, ensuring predictable latency and strict fault containment.

## Performance and Value
Benchmarks comparing an H100 GPU partition against a whole A100 GPU showed that a newer GPU slice can deliver **higher throughput** and lower latency at a significantly lower cost for high-concurrency workloads. This gives businesses more flexibility to right-size their AI infrastructure.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 现已支持 GPU 切片，帮你省下大笔 AI 部署费
zh.summary: 亚马逊 SageMaker 推理服务现在支持**英伟达 GPU 切片技术**，能把一块完整的显卡拆成**几个独立小块**。这个更新让企业能在单张显卡上同时跑多个 AI 模型，不仅互不干扰，还能大幅**压低云端部署成本**。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景与痛点
过去在云端部署 AI 模型时，最少只能租用一整块显卡。对于许多吃不了这么多显存的中小型模型来说，这就造成了极大的浪费。用户要么为用不到的算力买单，要么只能自己去折腾复杂的**集群运维**来做显卡切片。

## 运作方式
亚马逊 SageMaker 现在直接内置了英伟达的 GPU 切片功能，省去了用户自己搭建平台的麻烦。你只需要在配置里设定好**切片方案**，就能把不同的模型安排到不同的显卡小格子里。这种切片是在硬件层面隔离开的，既保证了**运行速度稳定**，又不会发生故障互相波及的情况。

## 性能与价值
实测表明，用一块更先进显卡切出来的小格子去跑模型，不仅**吞吐量更高**，而且在处理高并发任务时比老显卡更划算。这为企业精打细算、按需分配算力提供了极大的便利。

en.title: NVIDIA Open Source Tools Help Researchers Build 6G Networks
en.summary: NVIDIA's open source wireless tools, Aerial and Sionna, have seen rapid growth over the past year, surpassing **1 million downloads** globally. Researchers are using these platforms to develop AI-native 6G networks that help robots **react faster**, improve signal reception, save power, and accelerate network simulations.
en.long_summary:
Over the past year, adoption of NVIDIA's AI Aerial and Sionna software has surged 10x, with over **8,000 academic institutions** using the platforms. Researchers worldwide are leveraging these open source tools to build AI-native 6G networks designed to handle connectivity, computing, and sensing simultaneously.

At King’s College London, researchers connected a robot arm to an NVIDIA Jetson running Sionna, cutting task completion time by up to **52.6%** through goal-oriented semantic communications. Meanwhile, SoftBank and ETH Zurich demonstrated that AI-powered receivers can significantly improve signal recovery under heavy interference. Additionally, the University of Leeds used a portable 5G setup to reduce base station power consumption by **45.6%**, while CTTC accelerated network simulation runtimes from hours to just minutes using GPU acceleration.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具助力研究人员打造下一代 6G 网络
zh.summary: 英伟达的开源无线工具 Aerial 和 Sionna 在过去一年里迎来爆发式增长，全球下载量突破 **100 万次**。研究人员正在利用这些平台开发具备 AI 能力的 6G 网络，帮助机器人**反应更快**、提升信号接收能力、节省电力并加速网络模拟测试。
zh.long_summary:
在过去一年里，英伟达 AI Aerial 和 Sionna 软件的全球开发者采用率增长了 10 倍，吸引了全球超过 **8000 家研究和学术机构**使用。世界各地的研究人员正利用这些开源工具，构建旨在同时处理连接、计算和感知的 AI 原生 6G 网络。

在应用方面，伦敦国王学院的研究人员将机器人手臂连接到运行 Sionna 的英伟达边缘计算设备上，通过只传输关键物体的语义信息，将机器人任务完成时间缩短了最多 **52.6%**。软银集团和苏黎世联邦理工学院则通过集成神经网络接收器，显著改善了复杂干扰环境下的信号接收质量。此外，利兹大学利用便携式 5G 设备将基站功耗降低了 **45.6%**，而加泰罗尼亚电信技术中心则通过 GPU 加速，将复杂的网络模拟时间从数小时缩短至十几分钟。

en.title: NYT Cooking’s AI assistant saved my weeknight chicken, but almost ruined my cake
en.summary: I tested NYT Cooking's new AI assistant for ingredient swaps and recipe changes. It gave practical cooking guidance based on user comments and saved me a trip to the store. However, it can make mistakes like halving butter incorrectly, proving that AI is a **helpful sous chef** rather than the head chef.
en.long_summary: The new AI assistant integrated into NYT Cooking is designed to help users adapt recipes on the fly, answering questions about ingredient substitutions, scaling, and equipment changes. Unlike generic AI recipes, it draws from the publication's trusted database and user comments. During testing, it successfully helped modify a chicken and rice dish with available fridge items and converted a Bundt cake recipe into muffins. However, confusion can arise when switching between original and modified recipes within the app, highlighting the need for users to double-check quantities to avoid kitchen disasters.

zh.title: 纽约时报烹饪AI助手能帮我拯救晚饭的鸡肉，却差点毁了我的蛋糕
zh.summary: 我测试了《纽约时报》烹饪应用的AI助手，用来替换食材和修改食谱。它根据用户评论给出了实用的做饭建议，帮我省去了跑超市的麻烦。不过它也会犯错，比如差点把蛋糕黄油用量算错，这说明AI只是个**得力的副厨**，而不是大厨。
zh.long_summary: 《纽约时报》烹饪应用最近推出的AI助手，旨在帮用户随时随地修改食谱，解决食材替换、分量调整和厨具不够等问题。和那些不靠谱的纯AI食谱不同，它结合了该媒体的专业食谱库和海量用户评论。在实际测试中，它成功帮我用冰箱里现有的食材改造了一道鸡肉饭，还把复杂的环形蛋糕食谱改成了简单的玛芬蛋糕。不过，如果在应用里频繁切换原版和修改版食谱，一不小心容易搞混。这提醒我们在做饭时，还是要仔细核对用料，免得闹出笑话。

en.title: Midterm elections bring roadblocks for Elon Musk and AI data centers
en.summary: The recent midterm elections resulted in a major pushback against **AI data centers**, with voters rejecting expansion projects and electing politicians who promised tighter restrictions. Tech giants like **OpenAI** are already scrambling to change their secretive policies and rebrand data centers as compute campuses to appease the public.
en.long_summary: Following the historic Democratic victory in the midterms, the tech industry is facing a wave of political and public backlash. Tech billionaire Elon Musk, who donated half a billion dollars to Republicans, now finds his companies headquartered in a deeply blue state with little to show for his investment. Across the country, voters rejected ballot measures that would have sped up data center construction and instead passed restrictions. Critics argue that public anger was fueled by the secretive nature of tech companies, which often forced local officials to sign non-disclosure agreements while building massive facilities in water-scarce areas. In response, OpenAI has released a new compute campus policy blueprint promising more transparency and no more NDAs, though industry observers remain skeptical about whether rebranding data centers will actually solve the underlying power and environmental concerns.

zh.title: 美国中期选举后，埃隆·马斯克和AI数据中心要遇到麻烦了
zh.summary: 最近的中期选举给AI数据中心迎头痛击，选民们纷纷投票拒绝扩建项目，并选出了承诺加强监管的政客。像**OpenAI**这样的大厂已经坐立不安，开始紧急修改以往遮遮掩掩的政策，甚至把数据中心改名叫“计算园区”来平息民愤。
zh.long_summary: 随着民主党在美国中期选举中取得历史性胜利，科技行业正面临着一波政治和公众的强烈反弹。曾经砸下巨资支持共和党的埃隆·马斯克，如今发现自己的公司总部竟然落在一个极度变蓝的州里，几十亿砸下去几乎打了水漂。在全国范围内，选民们纷纷投票反对加快数据中心建设的提案，反而通过了各种限制性法规。分析认为，公众的怒火主要是被科技公司的秘密作风点燃的，这些公司在严重缺水的地方大兴土木时，经常要求地方官员签保密协议。为了应对这种压力，OpenAI最近发布了新的策略蓝图，承诺提高透明度并不再要求签保密协议，但业内人士对这种试图把数据中心“换个马甲”的做法能否真正解决能源和环保难题持怀疑态度。

en.title: thedotmack/claude-mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,595 | Your coding agent forgets everything between sessions and starts from scratch every time. **Claude-Mem** solves this by running a background observer that **captures session activity**, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into your future sessions. It works seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and many more, saving you tokens and preventing repeated mistakes.
en.long_summary:
## Introduction

**Claude-Mem** is an innovative tool designed to solve a universal frustration in AI-assisted coding: **agent amnesia**. Every time you start a new session, your coding agent forgets past conversations, files read, and mistakes already fixed. Claude-Mem acts as a persistent memory layer, running a secondary agent beside your main coding assistant to take notes, summarize activities, and inject vital context into future sessions.

## How It Works & Core Features

The system operates through a clever **three-step workflow**. When your agent works, hooks hand over tool calls to a local worker. An observer model turns this activity into concise observations. When a new session begins, your agent receives a compact index instead of a bloated history, fetching full details only when necessary through efficient MCP search tools.

- **Token Efficiency**: It saves up to 10x tokens by using a progressive disclosure strategy.
- **Wide Compatibility**: Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot CLI, and many other agents.
- **Privacy Control**: You can wrap sensitive information in private tags to keep secrets out of storage.

## Installation & Quick Start

Getting started is straightforward using Node.js. Run the interactive installer in your terminal to set up the worker service and configure your preferred AI agents:

```bash
npx claude-mem install
```

For specific agents like OpenCode or T3 Code, you can pass an explicit IDE flag during installation, such as `npx claude-mem install --ide opencode`.

## System Requirements & Configuration

Claude-Mem requires **Node.js 20.19+ or 22.12+**, along with Bun and SQLite. Settings can be easily customized in your local configuration file located at `~/.claude-mem/settings.json`, allowing you to adjust workflow modes, language preferences, and injection behaviors.

zh.title: thedotmack/claude-mem：为每个AI代理提供跨会话的持久化上下文记忆
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,595 | 你的AI编程助手在每次新会话开始时都会“失忆”，把之前聊过的内容忘得精光。**Claude-Mem** 完美解决了这个痛点，它在后台安排了一个“观察员”，默默**记录工作点滴**，用AI进行智能压缩，并在下次开工时自动把关键背景喂给AI。它支持主流的 Claude Code、Cursor 等各种代理工具，帮你省下大量Token并告别重复踩坑。
zh.long_summary:
## 项目介绍

**Claude-Mem** 旨在解决AI辅助编程中让人头疼的“健忘症”问题。每次开启新会话时，你的AI助手都会把之前读过的文件、做过的修改和修复好的错误忘得一干二净。而 Claude-Mem 通过在后台运行一个**观察员代理**，默默记录所有活动并用AI进行压缩，让你的AI助手拥有了跨会话的持久化记忆。

## 工作原理与核心功能

该系统采用了一套精巧的**三步工作流**。当你的AI写代码时，本地的监听服务会捕获工具调用，观察员会将其提炼成精简的观察记录。到了下一个会话，系统会自动注入一个紧凑的索引，让AI只在需要时才去查阅详细信息。

- **省时省Token**：通过渐进式披露策略，比直接丢一堆历史记录**节省高达10倍Token**。
- **广泛兼容**：支持 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Cursor 以及其他十几种主流编程代理工具。
- **隐私保护**：支持通过标签把敏感机密包裹起来，**绝对不被存储**。

## 安装与快速开始

安装非常简单，只需在装有 Node.js 的电脑终端中运行官方的交互式安装命令即可：

```bash
npx claude-mem install
```

如果你想为特定的开发工具单独配置，可以通过 `--ide` 参数指定，比如 `npx claude-mem install --ide opencode`。

## 系统要求与配置

运行该项目需要 **Node.js 20.19+ 或 22.12+** 环境，并会自动处理 Bun 和 SQLite 依赖。所有的个性化设置都可以通过修改 `~/.claude-mem/settings.json` 文件来完成，轻松调整语言、工作模式等参数。

en.title: Worktrunk: A Git worktree CLI for parallel AI agent workflows
en.summary: ⭐ 11,981 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool designed to **make git worktrees as easy as branches**. It solves the clumsy user experience of native git worktrees, enabling developers to seamlessly run and manage multiple AI agents in parallel without their changes conflicting.
en.long_summary:
## Background and Problem

Modern AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex can handle complex tasks autonomously, making it possible for developers to supervise **5-10+ agents in parallel**. While Git's native worktree feature gives each agent an isolated working directory, the command-line experience is clunky and requires typing branch names and paths multiple times.

## Core Features and Workflow

Worktrunk bridges this gap by treating worktrees as easily as standard branches. It offers simple core commands to switch, create, list, and clean up worktrees instantly. Advanced features include **workflow automation hooks**, AI-generated commit messages from diffs, an interactive picker with streaming CI status, and shared build caches that let multiple worktrees share dependencies like `node_modules` without re-copying.

## Installation and Quick Start

You can easily install Worktrunk via Homebrew, Cargo, Pacman, or Conda. Once installed, commands like `wt switch --create feature-auth` will automatically set up the branch and directory. When you are done, you can merge your changes locally using `wt merge main` or clean up the environment with a single command.

zh.title: Worktrunk：为并行 AI 代理工作流设计的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,981 | Worktrunk 是一个专门用来**简化 git 工作树管理**的命令行工具。它解决了原生 git 操作繁琐的痛点，让开发者能够顺畅地同时运行和管理多个 AI 代理，而不用担心代码改动互相打架。
zh.long_summary:
## 背景与痛点

像 Claude Code 和 Codex 这样现代的 AI 编程助手能够独立处理复杂的任务，这让开发者同时监督 **5 到 10 个以上的 AI 代理** 成为可能。虽然 Git 自带的工作树功能可以为每个代理提供独立的目录，但官方的操作体验非常繁琐，每次创建都要反复敲写很长的命令。

## 核心功能与工作流

Worktrunk 的出现就是为了让工作树的使用**像切换分支一样简单**。它提供了一套清爽的命令来快速创建、切换、查看和清理工作树。此外，它还带来了许多贴心的进阶功能，比如**自动化工作流钩子**、根据代码差异自动生成提交信息、带有 CI 状态的交互式选择器，以及可以让多个工作树共享 `node_modules` 等依赖的构建缓存机制。

## 安装与快速上手

你可以通过 Homebrew、Cargo、Pacman 或 Conda 轻松安装它。安装完成后，只需输入 `wt switch --create feature-auth` 就能瞬间搞定分支和目录的创建。任务完成后，你可以使用 `wt merge main` 直接在本地安全合并，或者用一条命令轻松清理战场。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using a Team of Auxiliary Execution Environments
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **Harness-S**, a new method to help AI agents learn better. Instead of relying on a single testing environment, it uses a pool of alternative execution setups to rescue failed attempts and **transfers those skills** into the main AI model, making it much more capable under the original testing conditions.
en.long_summary:
Training AI agents usually relies on a fixed execution environment, known as a harness, which often leads to rigid learning and frequent failures. This paper observes that different harness variants fix different problems, acting in complementary ways. Based on this, the authors developed Harness-S, which builds a reusable pool of specialized sibling harnesses. 

When all initial attempts under the original base harness fail, the system selects suitable auxiliary harnesses using an **adaptive router** powered by LLMs. Successful trajectories from these alternative setups are then used to replace the failed reinforcement learning rollouts. 

Experiments across multiple benchmarks like AppWorld and SWE-Gym show that models trained with this method **significantly outperform** standard training approaches when evaluated back on the original harness, proving that the helpful behaviors learned from auxiliary setups are successfully absorbed by the AI policy itself.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用多辅助运行环境训练更聪明的AI智能体
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一种名为 **Harness-S** 的AI训练新方法。当AI在基础测试环境中失败时，它会借助一组**备用运行环境**来帮AI通关，并把这些救援经验重新教给主模型，让它在回到原来的环境时变得**更加聪明能干**。
zh.long_summary:
训练AI智能体通常依赖单一的测试运行环境，但这种固定环境往往存在局限性，导致AI容易遇到瓶颈。研究发现，不同的环境变体可以修复不同类型的问题，彼此之间具有互补性。为此，研究团队推出了 Harness-S，它建立了一个包含多个专业辅助环境的**共享资源池**。

当AI在原本的测试环境中遭遇连续失败时，系统会利用大模型驱动的**智能路由器**，挑选出最合适的备用环境来协助通关。接着，这些辅助环境中成功的操作数据会被用来替代失败的强化学习记录，指导主模型进行学习。

在多个权威基准测试中的实验表明，采用这种方法训练出来的AI模型，在返回原始测试环境时表现**大幅超越**了传统训练方式，证明辅助环境中学会的技能被成功内化到了模型自身的基因中。
